reviewer: Codex visual inspection; not independent human verification
method: All 36 original/overlay triplets and all 114 isolated original/candidate crop pairs reviewed. Arrays follow 1-based displayed candidate order. S means the output substantially follows an identifiable round contour; F means clear shape/position mismatch, reflection, background, or invented closure; U retains uncertainty for occlusion, open curls or approximate edge alignment. S is not an engineering measurement or proof of a physical hole. No confidence interval or human precision claim is derived.

codes.U: uncertain contour; not counted as supported
codes.A: aperture appearance in photograph; no physical verification
